description: Studio apartment, 1 shower bathroom, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Single-aspect apartment — windows on top facade(s). Kitchen is on an interior wall away from windows — less natural light at the cooking position. Studio apartment. Sleeping area: double bed. Separation from living area: none. Kitchen: single-wall, no island. Cook faces the wall, back to the living and dining area. No wall separates kitchen from dining and living — fully open plan. Living area arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living. Dining table visible, approximately 4 seats. Bathroom config: 1 shower-only bathroom(s). Single bathroom — sequential morning routine. Storage room in entry or private zone, not adjacent to kitchen — suitable for coats, shoes, bikes, laundry or utility storage, not as kitchen pantry. Entry area has space for coat and shoe storage. From entry: kitchen is long corridor, living area is immediate. No door between entry and living/kitchen — relevant where local regulations require separation. Suits: singles or couples.
not_suitable_for: household requiring separate rooms for different functions simultaneously
jurisdictions requiring door separation between entry and kitchen
